description: Source code for CCS811 sensor driver trigger handling in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: ccs811_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as CO2 thresholds.

methods.name: setup_irq
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for the sensor.

methods.name: handle_irq
methods.description: Handles the interrupt by disabling and re-enabling IRQ.

methods.name: process_irq
methods.description: Processes the IRQ event, calling user handler if set.

methods.name: irq_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling IRQ in own thread configuration.

methods.name: work_cb
methods.description: Work handler for global thread trigger configuration.

methods.name: ccs811_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets trigger configuration for the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the sensor.
